About RomanceIQ

RomanceIQ is an illustrated romantic visual novel about three young adults, conflicting ambitions, and the complicated business of falling in love. Play the female lead and choose how she responds as attraction, secrets, and unexpected revelations test each relationship.

Read the story a few lines at a time beneath anime-inspired artwork, then make your choice when a decision appears. Explore this evolving prototype and discover where your choices lead.

How to play

  1. Click through the dialogue and consider each character’s words and motives.
  2. Choose your response when a decision appears to guide the story.
  3. Use the backtracking controls to revisit earlier questions and explore another choice.
